items.question: Do you treat children?
items.answer: Yes, we welcome patients of all ages including young children. Our team is trained in paediatric dentistry to make the experience comfortable.

items.question: Is root canal treatment painful?
items.answer: Modern root canal treatment is performed under local anaesthesia and is no more uncomfortable than a routine filling. Most patients are surprised at how painless the procedure is.

items.question: How often should I visit the dentist?
items.answer: We recommend a check-up and clean every six months to catch any issues early and keep your teeth and gums healthy.
